answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprint. Each identity logs a compact action signature per epoch; the rule requires future signatures to stay within a similarity ledge of its own prior history, so a clone cannot forge a matching trajectory without replaying real work. Any identity failing the cross-epoch match is decayed, and its accumulated relic of past rewards is forfeited. An attacker must therefore fund and operate every sockpuppet through many epochs at full cost.
